title: Terraria-readable icons: outlines, fuller framing, side-on guns, S-curve whips (sharded full rebuild)
player_outcome: Inventory icons read like Terraria sprites: chunky, saturated and outlined, filling the slot on the diagonal. Guns are drawn side-on with the barrel to the right, whips as an S-curve, and spear heads are lit.
design: Verified: render_icon (export.py:65-138) renders 128 px Cycles, 24 samples, no denoise, no outline. Weapons cover 1.7–7.7% of the frame. Guns are modelled in the YZ plane with width ±0.03 and viewed along +Y (edge-on black sticks).
'item' view: frame on the rotated diagonal with an icon-only thickness boost (pivot scaled 1.5× perpendicular to the blade) so coverage reaches ≥ 20%.
Render at 256 with denoising and downsample to 128 in Blender (image scale).
Compositor outline: alpha dilate 3 px (at 256), filled with the item's darkened median (×0.3), alpha-over under the render. Add a top-left rim light and the AgX 'Medium High Contrast' look.

New bgen/icon_views.py (moved from build_all._view_for): guns, launchers, drills and chainsaws → 'side' view (camera from +X, barrel right-up at 30°); whips → 'item' with generator param pose 's_curve' (whip lays out an S-curve lash when rendering icons); spears get an extra fill light on the head.

gear.gun: model the side profile in the XZ plane (grip −X, barrel +Z, depth along Y), or rotate 90° about Z at the end. Update sockets. Add style silhouette params: magazine, sights, stock; minishark/megashark shark fin and mouth; star_cannon star muzzle; space_gun ray-gun bulb. Chainsaw and drill get the same axis fix.
tools/textures/build_icons.py block icons get the same outline (Pillow dilate) for consistency.
build_all.py --shard=I/N also for item icons, then do the full rebuild of all ~1,554 icons in 4 shards.
files_modify: tools/blender/bgen/export.py — framing, 256→128, denoise, outline compositor, rim light, AgX
tools/blender/bgen/gear.py — gun/chainsaw/drill axis and silhouettes; whip s_curve pose
data_changes: assets.json gun params: style silhouettes for minishark/megashark/star_cannon/space_gun/flintlock_pistol/boomstick/sniper_rifle
tests: Throwaway coverage script: mean opaque coverage per generator ≥ 15% (swords/picks/guns)
verification: Contact sheet of 40 representative icons reviewed against Terraria sprites
risks: Full icon rebuild takes hours on CPU; shard it and use --samples 16 with denoise.
Gun axis change must keep the socket/grip correct (P3-06 uses sockets, so it stays correct automatically).
